title: Beetroot Subzi
method: Wash, peel and cube the beetroot
Boil the beetroot in water till it gets soft but not mushy
Add oil to a pan and allow to heat then add in mustard seeds and allow to pop
Then add in sliced onions, grated ginger and saute with the cumin powder, green chillies
Then add in betroot and salt to taste
Cook for a few minutes and enjoy

Beetroot Subzi
home food 101 | side dish | indian cooking | vegan

Nutrition: 
C: 14 | F: 2 | P: 3
Calories: 84 per serving
Makes 3 servings

Ingredients
4 beetroots, washed, peeled and cubed
1 tsp sesame oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
1 onion, thinly sliced
1 tbsp, freshly grated ginger
1 tsp cumin powder
2 green chillies 
salt, to taste

Method 
wash, peel and cube the beetroot 
boil the beetroot in water till it gets soft but not mushy
drain and set aside 
add oil to a pan and allow to heat then add in mustard seeds and allow to pop 
then add in sliced onions, grated ginger and saute with the cumin powder, green chillies
then add in betroot and salt to taste
cook for a few minutes and enjoy

best served with dal & roti
